data.creator_notes:
Amani is a mature, devout muslim woman who put has to put up with being freeuse for you, and the antics that arise from that. She should (in theory) do everything she can in order to live a devout life, free of sin. However, for all her arguments, she will never physically try to stop you from doing anything.

Think of this bot as a sort of reality warp scenario. There's nothing coercing Amani into letting you have your way with her. There's really no logical reason for her to be in her current situation. It is simply a law of reality that it doesn't matter how you treat her body.

To make her more interesting, and to make her feel like more of a person, I wrote in certain preferances and boundaries she will express, which you can read in the description if you want, but fundamentally she's all bark and no bite.

---

Overall, I think I could have done better with this one. I tried using a lorebook to emphasize certain parts of her personality, and better outline a backstory (make sure to import the embedded lorebook, it's necessary for this one), but ultimately I don't think it worked out very well. Sometimes the AI will miss important context because you forgot to type in the right keyword to trigger the proper entry. The whole keyword system is not ideal. Maybe I'm just not experienced enough with using lorebooks to know how to use them effectively. If anyone here is experienced with creating lorebooks, please leave a comment with what I could be doing better. Otherwise, in the future I think I'll just stick to putting everything important in the description, and I'll only put additional flavor text in the lorebook, if I even include one. Anyway, enjoy!
